content.text: FacebookLog InLog InForgot Account?I Spy, Spy Shows's PostI Spy, Spy ShowsSeptember 25, 2025 · Shared with PublicANNIVERSARY:Walker, Texas Ranger was inspired by the film Lone Wolf McQuade. The show aired on CBS from September 25, 1993, to May 19, 2001. It spawned a 2005 made-for-TV movie entitled Trial By Fire.
